subject: literacy
concept: Understanding synonyms and antonyms and choosing the most precise word for a context
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts word cards into synonym and antonym pairs
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a sentence to the word choice that best fits its tone or precision
exercise.abstract: Student replaces a plain word in a sentence with a more precise synonym

misconception_flags: chooses a synonym that technically matches but doesn't fit the sentence's tone or context

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
